note: The census now hands each root-relative displacement to the DEEPEST declared window containing it, so a record inside a sub-object is described by the record rather than lost. Windows come from route cells that already say EMBED <owner> +0xNN [stride count]; the hole between an element's size and its stride stays with the owner, because giving it to the element would invent a field the element does not declare.
